evidence.title: README (segment 2)
evidence.excerpt: API powered by Serverless Framework, TypeScript, Webpack, Node.js and DynamoDB, intended as a starting point for Serverless APIs. I've also created a [React/Redux-powered UI](https://github.com/jch254/serverless-node-dynamodb-ui) to front this API. Auth0 handles authentication. You must signup/login to generate an auth token and gain access to the secured area. All endpoints in the API check validity of the auth token and return unauthorised if invalid, the UI then prompts you to log in again. The API also determines the identity of the user via the auth token.

evidence.title: README (segment 3)
evidence.excerpt: See [Apiary](http://docs.serverlessapi.apiary.io) for API structure - defined in [apiary.apib](./apiary.apib).

evidence.title: README (segment 4)
evidence.excerpt: - Node.js 22 (`.nvmrc`, `package.json` engines, Dockerfile, and Lambda `nodejs22.x`) - pnpm 9.15.9 (`packageManager` in `package.json`) - Serverless Framework 4 - TypeScript 6 and Webpack 5 - AWS SDK v3 DynamoDB client - Auth0 JWT validation via `jsonwebtoken` - Local development with `serverless-offline` and `serverless-dynamodb`

evidence.title: README (segment 5)
evidence.excerpt: Serverless-webpack, serverless-dynamodb-local and serverless-offline offer great tooling for local Serverless development. To start local servers that mimic AWS API Gateway and DyanamoDB, run the commands below. Both servers will fire up and code will be reloaded upon change so that every request to your API will serve the latest code.

evidence.title: README (segment 6)
evidence.excerpt: Serverless-dynamodb-local requires Java Runtime Engine (JRE) version 6.x or newer.

evidence.title: README (segment 7)
evidence.excerpt: **AUTH0_CLIENT_SECRET environment variable must be set before `pnpm run dev` command below. Optional DYNAMODB_PORT and DYNAMODB_HOST environment variables may be set to override the defaults (localhost:8000).**

evidence.title: README (segment 8)
evidence.excerpt: Submit requests to http://localhost:3000. The DynamoDB shell console is available at http://localhost:8000/shell.
